gloss: overstatement; saying too much; going too far

definitions.gloss: overstatement; going too far (in what one says)
definitions.explanation: Saying more than is true or more than is fair: an exaggeration, or a remark that is too harsh. It is the noun form of {言|い}い{過|す}ぎる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}い{過|す}ぎだった。ごめん。
examples.english: I went too far yesterday. Sorry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{言|い}い{過|す}ぎで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ほど、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すばらしかった。
examples.english: His playing was so wonderful that it's no exaggeration to call him a genius.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{言|い}い{過|す}ぎで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it is no exaggeration to say ～
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{言|い}い{過|す}ぎ⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧？: aren't you going a bit far?
- {言|い}い{過|す}ぎた: I said too much (the verb, common in apologies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}→誇張：08680_kochou⟧: exaggeration (formal; deliberately making something bigger)
- {過言|かごん}: overstatement, used almost only in ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
